description: This line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a Whisper model with varying quantization methods and parameter settings, specifically for the 'tiny' model type. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents the WER, scaled linearly from 30 to 70. Five distinct lines are plotted, each corresponding to a different fine-tuning configuration: 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' (solid gray line with circle markers), 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' (dashed gray line with square markers), 'tiny int4' (dotted gray line with circle markers), 'tiny int8' (dash-dotted gray line with square markers), and 'tiny full' (dotted gray line with triangle markers). The 'tiny full' line starts at a WER of 30 at epoch 0 and gradually decreases to approximately 25 by epoch 6. The 'tiny int4' line begins at a WER of 70 and steadily declines to approximately 32 by epoch 6. The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' line starts at a WER of 70 and decreases to approximately 32 by epoch 6. The 'tiny int8' line starts at a WER of 60 and declines to approximately 37 by epoch 6. The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' line begins at a WER of 60 and decreases to approximately 38 by epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend in WER as training progresses, with the 'tiny full' model achieving the lowest WER throughout the training epochs.
